_source: Wolfgang's file (design/AD-magic-crafting-world.md). 'place' is the number counted in places from 5 the way the code keeps it: 0-10 as written, 10 + k is 10 + k, 0 - k is -k. Players are told only places 0-10 and the spectrums they hold (item 73).

surroundings._about: What puts each frequency into a place (engine/surroundings.py). Weights are FILL-INS, not Wolfgang's numbers: tune freely. Keys are places (5 = solids). Within `radius` metres; things count less with distance.

semi_skills._note: Semi skills (items 52, 47; the neodymium table: 'the semi skill from neodymium'): one basic skill per frequency held, weak, can be projectiled for attack. Each does what the neodymium table gives its frequency; 'power' and 'kind' are fill-ins. 'taxing' follows Wolfgang's words for the spectrum: taxing x3, very taxing x10, incredibly taxing x30 the amplitude for the same power. Frequency has no mass (item 85): every semi skill flies straight. The half places (5.5 hardening, 4.5 speed, 6.5 analysing; Wolfgang 11-19: 'the half is just a place marker for the fact that' these spectrums give access to more than one frequency) are second semi skills of solids, gas and liquid, with 50% amplitude loss ('impure'). 'lasting' ones stay on until stopped or unpaid, with upkeep every 10 s (item 24).

13.does: weights the odds: it cannot miss

10.does: destroys the target into the materials it is made from

9.does: raises the dead that have no soul

7.does: disperses the energy of the target

6.does: attracts liquids to a set distance

5.does: attracts solid things to a set distance

4.does: attracts gases to a set distance

0.does: creates an object from nearby materials

-1.what: a lump of matter made from energy

5.5.name: Hardening semi skill
5.5.does: hardens a person or object (item 21: what is hardened can't flex, so it moves slower)

4.5.name: Speed semi skill
4.5.does: decreases the friction of a person or object (item 22: how much it helps depends on strength)

6.5.name: Analysis semi skill
6.5.does: analyzes nearby materials for common names

direct._note: Direct skills and anything frequental on a person (items 13, 42, 48, and 'Weapons': no weapon or device can bypass the 10x remaining-amplitude or 10% max rule if frequental in nature and without consent): without consent it needs overpower: 10x the amplitude the person has remaining, and when they are exhausted or near it, 10% of their maximum (read as the target's). Thrown semi skills too. Creatures have no soul prism yet: a creature's amplitude is a fill-in, its level x creature_amplitude_per_level.

upkeep._note: Item 24: lasting effects cost exponential upkeep per 10 seconds. Fill-in: the k-th payment (k = 0, 1, 2...) is first_share x growth^k of the amplitude first put in.

_falloff_note: Wolfgang 11-19: frequency projectiles don't fall (no mass), but their power drops off with distance. Fill-in: it halves every falloff_half_m metres flown.

creatures._note: The world's own creatures (Wolfgang 11-19): frequencies fixed by what the creature is; they have only semi skills and minor racial skills. 'semi' is the one it throws when angry (none for the shy). Everyone holds 5. Racial: speed (x), shrugs_off (+, share of every blow its hide takes), attack (x). All fill-ins, matched by words in the creature's name (first match wins). Dungeon creatures are the world hoppers' and keep their magic (cores). Stereotypical magical creatures (Wolfgang 11-19: dragons, unicorns...) come first, so 'frost wolf' is matched as frost before wolf.
